info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Health Monitoring API
info.description: The Health Monitoring API provides real-time insights into the operational status of the microservices within the production environment. This endpoint allows users to check the health status of various components, ensuring that services are running optimally and to identify potential issues promptly. Typical consumers of this API include system administrators and DevOps teams monitoring system reliability and performance. By leveraging this API, users can maintain high availability and enhance overall service reliability.

get.summary: Check the health status of the application.
get.description: This endpoint provides a quick check on the application's health status. It returns a simple response indicating whether the application is operational or not, making it useful for monitoring and alerting purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to send health check parameters to the API. It allows clients to check the health status of the service to ensure it is operational.

200.description: The service is operational and healthy.

GetHealthStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the health operations endpoint. It is expected to be a string value.
